text: MedGuide Hospital, established in 2010, is a premier healthcare facility located in the bustling city of Nairobi, Kenya. Our hospital was founded with the vision of providing accessible, high-quality healthcare to the people of East Africa.

Our mission is to deliver patient-centered healthcare that prioritizes the well-being of our patients and their families. We believe in treating not just the illness but the whole person, ensuring that every patient feels valued and cared for.

At MedGuide Hospital, our General Medicine department provides comprehensive healthcare services for patients of all ages. From routine check-ups to managing chronic conditions, our team of experienced physicians is dedicated to ensuring your long-term health.

Our Surgery department is equipped with the latest technology to perform a wide range of procedures, from minimally invasive surgeries to complex operations. Our team of skilled surgeons is trained in various specialties, including orthopedic, cardiovascular, and gastrointestinal surgery.

The Maternity and Pediatrics department at MedGuide Hospital is designed to provide a safe and nurturing environment for mothers and children. Our maternity services include prenatal care, delivery, and postnatal support, while our pediatric team offers specialized care for infants, children, and adolescents.

Our Emergency Department operates 24/7 to provide immediate care for life-threatening conditions. With a fully equipped ER and a team of highly trained emergency physicians, we are prepared to handle everything from trauma cases to acute illnesses.

The Diagnostics department at MedGuide Hospital offers a wide range of imaging and laboratory services, including MRI, CT scans, X-rays, and blood tests. Our advanced diagnostic tools enable us to accurately identify and monitor medical conditions.

We offer specialized clinics in cardiology, oncology, orthopedics, neurology, and dermatology. Each clinic is staffed by experts in their respective fields, providing personalized care for patients with complex medical needs.

Our Cardiology department is dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of heart conditions. From routine check-ups to advanced procedures like angioplasty and bypass surgery, our team of cardiologists is committed to improving your heart health.

The Oncology department at MedGuide Hospital provides comprehensive cancer care, including chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and surgical oncology. Our multidisciplinary team works together to develop personalized treatment plans for each patient.

Our Orthopedics department specializes in the treatment of musculoskeletal conditions, including joint replacements, sports injuries, and fractures. Using the latest surgical techniques and rehabilitation methods, our orthopedic surgeons help patients regain mobility.

The Neurology department at MedGuide Hospital offers expert care for conditions affecting the brain and nervous system, such as stroke, epilepsy, and migraines. Our neurologists use advanced diagnostic tools and treatment methods to provide effective care.

Our Dermatology department provides comprehensive care for skin conditions, including acne, eczema, and skin cancer. Our dermatologists are skilled in both medical and cosmetic treatments, helping patients achieve healthy and radiant skin.

Dr. Jane Mwangi is the Chief Medical Officer at MedGuide Hospital and a renowned cardiologist with over 20 years of experience. She completed her medical training at the University of Nairobi and has since dedicated her career to improving heart health in Kenya.

Dr. Peter Omondi is the Head of Surgery and a highly skilled orthopedic surgeon. He specializes in joint replacements and sports medicine, helping patients regain mobility and return to their active lifestyles.

Dr. Lucy Wanjiru is the Head of Pediatrics and a dedicated pediatrician with a passion for child health. She completed her training at the University of Nairobi and has since worked tirelessly to improve the health and well-being of children in Kenya.

Dr. Ahmed Ali is the Head of Oncology and a leading cancer specialist in East Africa. He has extensive experience in the diagnosis and treatment of various cancers, including breast, lung, and prostate cancer.

Dr. Susan Kamau is the Head of Emergency Medicine and a highly experienced emergency physician. She has trained in some of the best hospitals in the world and brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to MedGuide Hospital.
Our private and semi-private rooms are designed with patient comfort in mind. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, including adjustable beds, flat-screen TVs, and en-suite bathrooms.

Our cafeteria offers a variety of healthy and delicious meals, prepared by professional chefs. We understand the importance of nutrition in the healing process and strive to provide meals that are both nutritious and satisfying.

We offer free high-speed internet access to all patients and visitors. Whether you need to stay connected for work or simply want to browse the web, our Wi-Fi service ensures that you can stay connected during your stay.
Our secure parking facility is available for patients and visitors, ensuring that you can easily access the hospital without worrying about your vehicle.
We have a dedicated prayer room for patients and visitors who wish to meditate or pray. This quiet space is designed to provide a sense of peace and tranquility during your time at the hospital.
We accept all major insurance providers, including NHIF, AAR Healthcare, Jubilee Insurance, CIC Insurance, and Britam Health.
Our General OPD operates from Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM. Emergency services are available 24/7, and specialized clinics operate by appointment only.
MedGuide Hospital is located at 123 Wellness Avenue, Nairobi, Kenya. Our central location makes us easily accessible to patients from all parts of the city.

MedGuide Hospital is committed to giving back to the community. Every month, we organize free health camps in underserved areas, providing check-ups, vaccinations, and health education to those in need.

We believe that education is key to preventing illness and promoting health. That’s why we regularly host workshops on topics like diabetes, hypertension, and maternal health. These workshops are open to the public and aim to empower individuals with the knowledge they need to lead healthy lives.

MedGuide Hospital collaborates with local NGOs and government health programs to address the healthcare needs of the community. Through these partnerships, we are able to reach more people and make a greater impact.

At MedGuide Hospital, we use advanced electronic health records to ensure that patient information is securely stored and easily accessible. This system allows our doctors to provide more coordinated and efficient care.
We offer telemedicine services to patients who are unable to visit the hospital in person. Through virtual consultations, our doctors can provide expert care from the comfort of your home.
Our state-of-the-art robotic surgery system allows for minimally invasive procedures, resulting in faster recovery times and less pain for our patients.

MedGuide Hospital has been recognized with several awards, including Best Hospital in Kenya (2022) and Excellence in Patient Care (2021). We are also ISO 9001 Certified and Joint Commission International (JCI) Accredited.

We are always looking for talented healthcare professionals to join our team. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of patients, we would love to hear from you. Current openings include nurses, doctors, lab technicians, and administrative staff.

For more information, please visit us at 123 Wellness Avenue, Nairobi, Kenya. You can also contact us by phone at +254 700 123 456, by email at info@medguidehospital.co.ke, or through our website at www.medguidehospital.co.ke.

MedGuide Hospital offers a wide range of medications, including antibiotics like Amoxicillin and Ciprofloxacin, which are used to treat bacterial infections. Our pharmacy ensures that all medications are stored and dispensed under strict quality control measures.

For pain management, we provide medications such as Paracetamol, Ibuprofen, and Morphine. These are carefully prescribed based on the patient’s condition and medical history to ensure safety and effectiveness.
Our hospital stocks antidiabetic medications like Metformin and Insulin for managing diabetes. These are essential for regulating blood sugar levels and preventing complications.
For cardiovascular conditions, we offer medications such as Atenolol, Amlodipine, and Warfarin. These help manage high blood pressure, heart disease, and blood clotting disorders.

MedGuide Hospital provides antiretroviral therapy (ART) for HIV patients, including drugs like Tenofovir and Efavirenz. These medications are critical for managing HIV and improving patients’ quality of life.
Our oncology department uses chemotherapy drugs such as Paclitaxel and Cisplatin for cancer treatment. These medications are administered under strict supervision to minimize side effects.
For respiratory conditions, we offer inhalers like Salbutamol and corticosteroids such as Prednisone. These help manage asthma, COPD, and other lung diseases.
MedGuide Hospital provides immunosuppressants like Cyclosporine for patients undergoing organ transplants. These medications prevent organ rejection and are closely monitored.

Our psychiatry department offers antidepressants like Fluoxetine and antipsychotics such as Risperidone. These medications are used to treat mental health conditions like depression and schizophrenia.
For gastrointestinal disorders, we provide medications like Omeprazole for acid reflux and Loperamide for diarrhea. These help manage digestive issues effectively.
MedGuide Hospital stocks vaccines such as Hepatitis B, HPV, and COVID-19 vaccines. These are essential for preventing infectious diseases and promoting public health.
Our anesthesia department uses medications like Propofol and Sevoflurane for general anesthesia during surgeries. These ensure patients are pain-free and unconscious during procedures.
For anticoagulation therapy, we provide medications like Heparin and Rivaroxaban. These are used to prevent blood clots in patients with conditions like deep vein thrombosis (DVT).
MedGuide Hospital offers antihistamines like Cetirizine for allergy relief. These medications help manage symptoms like sneezing, itching, and rashes.
Our dermatology department provides topical treatments like Hydrocortisone cream for skin conditions. These are effective for managing eczema, psoriasis, and other skin disorders.
For thyroid disorders, we offer medications like Levothyroxine. These help regulate thyroid hormone levels and manage conditions like hypothyroidism.
MedGuide Hospital provides antimalarial drugs like Artemether-Lumefantrine. These are essential for treating and preventing malaria, a common disease in the region.
Our neurology department uses anticonvulsants like Carbamazepine for epilepsy. These medications help control seizures and improve patients’ quality of life.
For osteoporosis, we provide medications like Alendronate. These help strengthen bones and reduce the risk of fractures in elderly patients.
MedGuide Hospital offers antiviral medications like Acyclovir for herpes infections. These are effective in managing viral outbreaks and reducing symptoms.
Our hospital provides iron supplements and erythropoietin for anemia. These help increase red blood cell production and improve energy levels.
For fungal infections, we offer antifungal medications like Fluconazole. These are used to treat conditions like candidiasis and ringworm.
MedGuide Hospital stocks emergency medications like Adrenaline for anaphylaxis. These are critical for managing life-threatening allergic reactions.
Our hospital provides medications for hypertension, including Lisinopril and Hydrochlorothiazide. These help control high blood pressure and prevent complications.
For migraines, we offer medications like Sumatriptan. These help relieve severe headaches and improve patients’ quality of life.
MedGuide Hospital provides medications for Parkinson’s disease, including Levodopa. These help manage symptoms like tremors and stiffness.
Our hospital offers medications for rheumatoid arthritis, including Methotrexate. These help reduce inflammation and slow disease progression.
For tuberculosis, we provide medications like Rifampicin and Isoniazid. These are part of the standard TB treatment regimen.
MedGuide Hospital stocks medications for glaucoma, including Timolol eye drops. These help reduce intraocular pressure and prevent vision loss.
Our hospital provides medications for gout, including Allopurinol. These help reduce uric acid levels and prevent painful flare-ups.
For insomnia, we offer medications like Zolpidem. These help patients achieve restful sleep and improve overall well-being.
MedGuide Hospital provides medications for chronic kidney disease, including Phosphate binders. These help manage complications and improve patients’ quality of life.
Our hospital offers medications for multiple sclerosis, including Interferon beta. These help slow disease progression and manage symptoms.
For hepatitis C, we provide medications like Sofosbuvir. These are part of the antiviral treatment regimen to cure the infection.
MedGuide Hospital stocks medications for Alzheimer’s disease, including Donepezil. These help manage cognitive symptoms and improve patients’ quality of life.
Our hospital provides medications for ADHD, including Methylphenidate. These help improve focus and reduce hyperactivity in patients.
For Crohn’s disease, we offer medications like Infliximab. These help reduce inflammation and manage symptoms effectively.
MedGuide Hospital provides medications for lupus, including Hydroxychloroquine. These help manage symptoms and prevent disease flares.
Our hospital offers medications for cystic fibrosis, including Ivacaftor. These help improve lung function and overall health.
For psoriasis, we provide medications like Methotrexate. These help reduce skin inflammation and improve patients’ quality of life.
MedGuide Hospital stocks medications for bipolar disorder, including Lithium. These help stabilize mood and prevent manic episodes.
Our hospital provides medications for chronic pain, including Gabapentin. These help manage pain and improve patients’ daily functioning.
For asthma, we offer medications like Montelukast. These help reduce inflammation and prevent asthma attacks.
MedGuide Hospital provides medications for epilepsy, including Valproic acid. These help control seizures and improve patients’ quality of life.
Our hospital offers medications for hypertension, including Losartan. These help control high blood pressure and prevent complications.
For diabetes, we provide medications like Glimepiride. These help regulate blood sugar levels and prevent complications.
MedGuide Hospital stocks medications for osteoporosis, including Risedronate. These help strengthen bones and reduce the risk of fractures.
